rectifierReplay.method: Pass opaque black source pixels through the actual production rectifier with white padding; compare its synthetic white coverage to the independent homography calculation.

rootCauseEvidence.roundChecker: The detector reports needs_review, only 11%/22% cap-outline support and 81% first-cap colour loss, yet a high 92%/96% local lower-edge score. Lower-line intersection is fixed in later cap refinement. The high local edge score does not establish that the lines describe this heart.
rootCauseEvidence.rectification: Production rectify() blends out-of-source samples with white and preprocessPixels() provides no observation-coverage weight. The bottom-flower template score therefore includes synthetic padding as if observed colour. The independent opaque-black replay confirms the padding fraction.
rootCauseEvidence.benchmarkMeaning: The 26/31 number counts valid templates fitting estimated rectified masks. It is not a count of verified physical crops or recovered ground-truth cutting paths.

next: Preserve the existing frozen benchmark and report crop diagnostics alongside template/image passes.
